description: Replay Engine - reconstruct task execution timelines for debugging and audit, building complete timelines with lifecycle events, delegation chains, cost accumulation, and checkpoints.
steps: Create src/nexus/runtime/replay.py with the following components:
TimelineEventType enum: CREATED, STARTED, DELEGATED, RETRIED, COMPLETED, FAILED, ESCALATED, CHECKPOINT, COST_INCURRED
TimelineEvent dataclass: timestamp datetime, event_type TimelineEventType, description str, agent_id UUID|None, details dict[str, Any] (flexible metadata), cost_cents int default 0
TaskReplay dataclass: task_id UUID, task_title str, started_at datetime|None, completed_at datetime|None, timeline list[TimelineEvent] (ordered by timestamp), stats ReplayStats
ReplayStats dataclass: total_duration_seconds float|None, total_cost_cents int, total_retries int, delegation_depth int, event_count int
ReplayEngine class: __init__(). Internal storage: dict[UUID, list[TimelineEvent]] mapping task_id to events.

Methods on ReplayEngine: record_event(task_id: UUID, event_type: TimelineEventType, description: str, agent_id: UUID|None = None, details: dict|None = None, cost_cents: int = 0), get_replay(task_id: UUID) -> TaskReplay|None (builds complete timeline sorted by timestamp, computes stats), get_delegation_chain(task_id: UUID) -> list[UUID] (extract unique agent_ids from DELEGATED events in order), get_cost_breakdown(task_id: UUID) -> list[tuple[str, int]] (event description + cost for COST_INCURRED events), list_tasks_with_events() -> list[UUID]

Create tests/test_replay_engine.py: Test event recording, get_replay timeline ordering, stats computation (duration, cost, retries, delegation_depth), delegation_chain extraction, cost_breakdown, empty task handling, multiple tasks isolation
acceptance_criteria: ReplayEngine records events and builds complete TaskReplay with ordered timeline
ReplayStats correctly computes total_duration, total_cost, total_retries, delegation_depth
get_delegation_chain returns ordered unique agent IDs from delegation events
get_cost_breakdown returns accurate cost per event
Multiple tasks are isolated from each other
findings: All 32 tests pass. Full suite at 1059 tests with no regressions. Module exported via runtime __init__.py.
